articles.title: The Gallagher Brothers Finally Sat Down Together — and Cameras Were Rolling!
articles.summary: Liam and Noel Gallagher from Oasis did their first interview together in over 25 years. It's part of a new documentary about their huge 2025 comeback tour. The film hits IMAX theaters on September 11, then Disney+.

articles.title: Country Star Elizabeth Cook Plays Herself (Sort Of) in a Funny New Movie
articles.summary: Country singer Elizabeth Cook stars in "The Easy Kind," a mostly-true movie where she plays a version of herself named EC. It's about making music your own way, even when life gets messy. The film opens in theaters on June 3.

articles.title: Tony Leung Talks to Trees Now — and a New Movie Explains Why
articles.summary: Actor Tony Leung says making the film "Silent Friend" changed how he sees plants. He now thinks they are sentient beings, just like people. In the movie, he plays a scientist studying a tree during the pandemic.
